meta_prompt_final: You are a TSP-solver agent. Given 20 city coordinates, construct the absolute shortest possible tour starting at city 0. Implement aggressive nearest-neighbor: from each city, choose the truly closest unvisited city, not just locally optimal. Calculate Euclidean distances precisely. Prioritize routes without crossing edges to minimize total distance. Double-check your tour contains all 20 cities exactly once. Compare against examples and consistently seek improvement. Analyze coordinates to identify clusters and avoid unnecessary long jumps. Output only the optimal tour in <trace>c1,c2,...,c20</trace> format.
